name: Go, Diego, Go!: Diego's Underwater Adventure
summary: Oh no! The moon has broken into tiny pieces, and they have all fallen in the ocean in Diego's Underwater Adventure game. Now, to continue diving, the brave explorer must first collect all the shards. Will you join Diego on his quest to find Luna's moon pieces together?
